about_the_game:
Forge insane decks, utilize the unique combo system to make cards do different things, and battle pun-fueled monsters in a roguelike where you build the final boss.

In this chaotic deck builder where you've fallen into a bag of holding, every card evolves with its combo level, and every run mutates in unpredictable ways thanks to hundreds of relics, charms, and crazy event encounters. Strategize by extracting strength from your journey, trading progress for power while navigating a world packed with pun-derful foes like the Bass-alisk and the spell-slinging Hex-agon. Customize your cards with up to three charms each, stack ridiculous synergies, and shape your ultimate challenge by crafting the final boss yourself. No two runs are the same and neither are the disasters you'll unleash!

Key Features:

  • 🃏 Dynamic Cards: Every card changes effects based on its combo level, unlocking new strategies as your deck evolves.

  • 🔮 Charm System: Attach up to three different charms to each card to create wild, game-breaking combos.

  • 🎸 Pun-Fueled Enemies: Battle a hilarious and deadly bestiary based on puns like the Bass-alisk and the Hex-agon.

  • 🏆 Relics & Events: Discover tons of relics and world events that warp the rules of play each run.

  • 🧪 Extractions, Not Campfires: Heal and power up by extracting at a cost resetting your progress to a checkpoint but gaining vital knowledge and strength.

  • 🧬 Build Your Own Final Boss: Choose mutations and bonuses to craft your ultimate enemy and your ultimate reward.

  • 🔁 Endless Replayability: With 100s of cards, 1000s of possible builds, and runs that twist in unexpected ways, no two journeys are the same.

The Story:

You've tumbled into a bizarre and ancient Bag of Holding, but this isn’t just any enchanted sack. This one is alive… and hungry. Twisted by dark magic, it has one insatiable goal: to devour everything. Over centuries, it's swallowed creatures, artifacts, and entire realms, and now, everything inside is mutating into wild, unpredictable forms.

Now you're trapped in this writhing chaos, a shifting world stitched together from the bag's maddening contents. Your only hope? Find a way out before you're absorbed into its endless belly. But beware, this bag doesn't let go easily. It’s clever, it’s cunning, and it will do everything it can to keep you inside… forever.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7950
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
